Chapter 426 - 426 Gaming Helmet (2)

Chapter 426 - 426 Gaming Helmet (2)

426 Gaming Helmet (2)

“Lil White!”

“I’m here, Master!” The super smart watch on his wrist made a crisp sound.

“Help me register a patent for the gaming helmet and write a thesis on it,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright, Master,” said Lil White.

Then, the super smart watch shot out a red light.

About ten minutes later, patent documents from countries all over the world appeared on the display of the super smart watch.

“Master, the patent for the gaming helmet has been registered.

“Also, the thesis on the gaming helmet has been sent to your email.”

As soon as Lil White finished speaking, Lin Fan’s phone vibrated.

An email popped up.

It was titled ‘Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets,’ which Lil White had just edited.

Lin Fan glanced around and said, “Lil White, not bad! The first author will be me, and the second authors will be Qiu Junxiong, Liu Wei, Wu Tian, and Zheng Qian.”

“Then, send the thesis to… Nature’s editorial department. They should review it as quickly as possible.”

“Yes, Master!” Lil White said.

Suddenly, Lin Fan, Qiu Junxiong, Liu Wei, Wu Tian, and Zheng Qian’s names appeared out of thin air in the thesis.

Then, Lil White sent it directly to Nature’s editorial department.

Suddenly, Lin Fan thought of something and asked, “Lil White, can you develop a game that suits the gaming helmet?”

“Sure,” Lil White said.

“That’s great!” Lin Fan said happily.

After all, he was very interested in the gaming helmet.

However, he had a headache because he needed to design a game.

This feeling was like having a treasure mountain, but there was an incomparably long and rugged mountain road ahead.

Lil White was able to help with the design. It was like adding a ropeway to a long, rugged mountain road! It was so convenient!

“What kind of game do you want, Master?” asked Lil White.

“Adventure category!” Lin Fan replied without hesitation.

“Alright, Master.” Lil White said.

About ten minutes later…

Lil White said, “Master, a game has been installed on your spare phone. It’s called World.”

“Alright!” Lin Fan said happily.

The game was installed, and he could enter the game immediately!

Lin Fan quickly picked up his spare phone. Indeed, there was an unfamiliar icon with the word ‘World’ on it.

Then, Lin Fan lay down on the bed and connected the gaming helmet to his backup phone.

At this moment, a crisp notification sounded out in Lin Fan’s ear.

“Do you wish to activate the gaming helmet?”

“Activate!” Lin Fan said.

Hiss!

Lin Fan felt his neck tighten.

The next moment, Lin Fan’s vision turned dark.

A crisp sound rang out in his ears again.

“Welcome to the gaming helmet.”

Then, a row of floating characters appeared in front of Lin Fan.

“Enter World?”

Lin Fan did not hesitate at all and said, “Yes!”

In the next moment…

A patch of green grassland appeared in front of Lin Fan.

A gust of wind blew. He could feel the cool breeze and the touch of the grass.

When Lin Fan raised his head, he could see sparrows flying across the sky and the warm sun hanging in the air.

All of this…

Everything was so real.

In fact, Lin Fan had a strange feeling.

It was as if he was not in the game at all but had entered a real world.

Lin Fan walked into the distance slowly.

Before long, a sea of flowers appeared in front of them.

Red, blue, purple… It was very beautiful.

The air was filled with a rich fragrance.

At this moment, a long snake with patterns all over its body suddenly darted out from the sea of flowers. It spat out venom and quickly slithered toward Lin Fan.

When Lin Fan saw this, he hurriedly retreated.

However, the more he retreated, the more the snake closed in.

In the next moment…

The snake sped up and bared its sharp teeth, wanting to bite Lin Fan’s calf.

Lin Fan quickly dodged.

If this were the outside world, Lin Fan would have become a superhuman existence after consuming the Constitution Enhancement Potion multiple times.

With his speed and strength, he could easily take care of the snake.

However, in the virtual world..

His strength and speed were only on par with ordinary people.

It was really difficult to dodge the long snake.

In fact, Lin Fan was bitten by a long snake in the calf.

A piercing pain assaulted his heart.

Immediately after, his entire body felt numb.

After a while, the world in front of him suddenly shattered.

“You died. Game over.” A crisp voice rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

He entered the game and was bitten to death by a snake in the blink of an eye?

Lin Fan could not help but reveal an awkward look.

“Do you wish to re-enter the game?”

“Yes!”

In the next moment, Lin Fan appeared once again on the boundless plains.

This time, he did not move forward immediately.

Instead, he found a suitable wooden stick and two stones.

Then, he continued to walk toward the flowers.

As expected, the long snake appeared again.

Lin Fan grinned. “Good!”

Then, he raised the stick and slapped the long snake.

When the long snake was on its last breath, he did not forget to smash it with a stone, completely ending its life.

At this moment, a faint light flashed in the snake’s head that had been smashed into meat paste.

“The Spirit Wind Pill is a mysterious spiritual energy within the Spirit Snake’s body. After consumption, it can increase speed by ten points!”

A notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

Seeing this…

Only then did Lin Fan reveal a look of realization.

No wonder this snake moved so fast. It turned out that there was such a thing inside its body.

Kill monsters and steal treasures?

This game seemed to be quite interesting.

As Lin Fan thought about this, he slowly lowered his head and picked up the Spirit Wind Pill.

Although the Spirit Wind Pill was inside the snake’s body, there was not a trace of blood or stench on it. There was still a faint glow on its surface.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and put it into his mouth.

The moment the Spirit Wind Pill entered his mouth, his entire body felt a slight chill.

Then, Lin Fan walked over quickly. His speed was obviously much faster.

This made Lin Fan even more interested in the game.

He continued forward and arrived at a dense forest.

Among them, there were a few crystal clear fruits on one of the trees.

Curious, Lin Fan plucked a fruit and put it into his mouth.

It was juicy, sweet, and delicious.

Lin Fan could not help but praise, “I didn’t think that my taste buds would work in the game.”

When he finished eating the fruit, a crisp notification sounded in his mind.

[Consuming an Energy Fruit will increase strength by ten points.]

As expected, Lin Fan could feel a surge of energy within his body.

He looked at the remaining fruits above his head, and his eyes lit up completely.

Without any hesitation, he picked another fruit and put it into his mouth.

Sweet and crisp!

Delicious!

At the same time, his strength increased once again!

When Lin Fan plucked another fruit and was halfway through eating, an ape suddenly jumped down from the tree.

It bared its teeth and roared continuously.

When he saw the remaining half of the fruit in Lin Fan’s hand, he seemed to be completely furious. He raised his hand and slapped Lin Fan’s head.

Luckily, Lin Fan had taken the Spirit Wind Pill, so his speed had increased by quite a bit.

Finally, he successfully dodged the ape’s attack.

However, the ape did not give up.

It continued to attack.

Lin Fan dodged a few times and knew that continuing was not the way. He took out the stone he had prepared and found an opportunity to hit the ape’s head.

After eating two energy fruits, Lin Fan’s strength was not bad either.

The stone smashed down, directly hitting the ape until it took two steps back.

Lin Fan understood that the ape was not invincible, so he smacked its head again.

Fast, accurate, ruthless!

Two consecutive smacks directly scared away the ape.

Meanwhile, Lin Fan continued to eat the Energy Fruits and played the game happily.

…

Lin Fan was happy, but some people were the complete opposite.
